notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top and band examples are almost all health/medical text (patients, drugs like ranolazine, vaccines, physiotherapy, disclaimers), and the output suppresses/promotes clinical vocabulary; census shows 50% of diseases but 0% of objects. Near misses use other professional domains and the + pole's safety/hazard-adjacent style, keeping frames parallel.
